correctness.rationale: For columns a,b in {0,...,7}, maj(a_r,a_(r+1),b_r)=a_r iff a_r=a_(r+1) or b_r=a_r. Uniform columns 0,7 have all 8 successors, whereas each nonuniform column has precisely itself and its next symbol along 1->3->2->6->4->5->1; no nonuniform-to-uniform edges. A cyclic word therefore lies wholly in the uniform two-symbol component (2^n states) or on the six-loop cycle (6 sum_{6|k} binom(n,k) states). The sixth-roots filter gives the exact cosine formula and sqrt(3)<2 proves the two classes have asymptotic proportion 1/2 each. An independently built 8-state adjacency matrix reproduced all 28 directed edges and traces for n=3..12; this corroborates, not replaces, the all-n argument. Definitions require labelled 3-row torus n>=3 and synchronous NEC including incumbent, not four-neighbor majority.
